claim: 1000ExM is a four-network interpenetrating hydrogel expanding from ~18-fold to >1000-fold linear, a billion-fold in volume
quote: We introduce thousandfold expansion microscopy (1000ExM), a four-network interpenetrating hydrogel architecture that enables successive expansion from ~18-fold to >1000-fold (one billion-fold in volume)

claim: The method's premise is anchoring side chains, cleaving backbone amide bonds, and expanding residues apart to image them separately
quote: individual protein residues could be imaged by anchoring their side chains to a swellable polymer, cleaving backbone amide bonds, and expanding residues away from each other

claim: Adjacent alpha-carbon distance is ~0.38 nm, which 1000x expansion turns into ~380 nm, above the ~200-300 nm diffraction limit
quote: the distance between adjacent alpha carbon (Cα) atoms in a protein backbone, where side chains are attached, is ~0.38 nm. After 1000× expansion, this distance would become ~380 nm, within the resolvable range of conventional microscopy

claim: The original iterative ExM gel with neutral re-embedding gave 44-52x but became mechanically dense and diffusion-restrictive
quote: despite achieving ~44–52× linear expansion, became mechanically dense and diffusion-restrictive, which impedes downstream steps

claim: Replacing Bis crosslinking with sodium acrylate/DMAA gave ~10x per round and ~96x over five rounds
quote: this gel expanded ~10× per round, and enabled ~96× total expansion when alternated with neutral re-embedding, for a total of 5 rounds

claim: Reducing initiator concentration while keeping full polymerization raised single-round expansion to ~18x
quote: Systematic reduction of initiator concentration, while maintaining full polymerization, could increase single-round expansion to ~18×

claim: A cleavable acrylamide/DATD re-embedding scaffold raised five-network totals from ~96x to ~270x and up to ~718x
quote: This increased total expansion, for a 5-network gel, from ~96× to ~270×, and up to ~718× when combined with a further optimized reembedding gel formulation

claim: The DATD route was abandoned because periodate cleavage might not be selective and could damage the SA/DMAA network
quote: we were concerned that periodate cleavage would not be selective to the DATD scaffold [5] and could potentially damage the co-polymerized SA/DMAA network

claim: Casting a charged gel directly inside an expanded charged gel contracted it only from ~18x to ~10x, a stable partially swollen state
quote: the expanded gel contracted only from ~18× to ~10×, and reached a stable, partially swollen state

claim: Each subsequent casting step contracted the gel by only about 50%, keeping the network from becoming too dense
quote: Across four rounds, contraction was only ~50% of the expanded state for each subsequent casting step, preventing the network from becoming overly dense

claim: Four sequential SA/DMAA networks gave 18x to ~100x to ~500x to ~1500x with no neutral re-embedding
quote: sequential casting of four optimized SA/DMAA networks produced 18× →

claim: In phosphate buffered saline the final gel stabilized at ~1000x
quote: Upon exposure to phosphate buffered saline (PBS), the final gel stabilized at ~1000×

claim: Two monomer incubations per casting round gave median ~1900x and up to 2534x linear expansion
quote: produced four-network gels with median ~1900×, and reaching up to 2534×, linear expansion

claim: The nanobody nanoruler carried two fluorophores about 4 nm apart in four-lysine ExM cassettes at the termini
quote: consisting of 4 lysines at the N- and C-termini of the nanobody [15]. The fluorophores are separated by ~4 nm

claim: At 18x the 4 nm separation is still ~72 nm, below the diffraction limit, so early rounds needed ONE microscopy
quote: At low expansion factors, this separation is below the diffraction limit (4 nm × 18× ≈ 72 nm), so early rounds were imaged using one-step nanoscale expansion (ONE) microscopy

claim: Measured fluorophore separations scaled proportionally with expansion, giving an inferred biological distance of ~4 nm
quote: This normalization yielded an inferred biological distance of ~4 nm, consistent with the expected labeling distance

claim: Outlying nanobody distances were attributed to only one fluorophore surviving gelation, so the nearest neighbour lay on an adjacent nanobody
quote: most likely due to measurements in which only one fluorophore on a specific nanobody survives the gelation procedure, implying that its nearest neighbor will be found on an adjacent nanobody

claim: The nanobody was modelled as a rigid ~4 nm globular object with fluorophores on ~1 nm flexible lysine linkers, not an atomic structure
quote: The nanobody is approximated as a rigid ~4 nm globular object with two fluorophores attached via ~1 nm flexible lysine linkers

claim: Fluorescein peak positions from simple 2D averages matched MD-predicted amino acid positions at both 18x and 1000x
quote: Fluorescein peak positions measured from these averages matched positions predicted by MD ensemble model, both at low expansion (18×; Fig. 2D) and at high expansion (1000×; Fig. 2E)

claim: Measured and modelled distributions agreed closely: R2 = 0.86 for peak number and R2 = 0.85 for peak positions
quote: A high similarity is observed (R2 = 0.86 for the number of spots, p = 0.0028, n = 7 gel types; R2 = 0.85 for the

claim: Distances from Atto647N to the first fluorescein peak and between adjacent peaks were statistically indistinguishable from modelled values
quote: Distances between the Atto647N signal and the first fluorescein peak, as well as distances between adjacent fluorescein peaks, were statistically indistinguishable from modeled values

claim: Simple 2D averaging sufficed to reveal amino-acid-level positions, with no specialised or user-biased analysis
quote: a simple 2D averaging of signals is sufficient to reveal amino acid-level positions in mCLING images, without any specialized (or user-biased) analysis procedures

claim: A putative peptide was defined as one Atto647N dye with at least four fluorescein dyes
quote: A putative peptide was defined as containing one Atto647N dye accompanied by at least four fluorescein dyes

claim: mCLING's central palmitoyl tail interacts with the C-terminal Atto647N, giving a predominantly curved C-shaped conformation
quote: The mCLING peptide contains a central palmitoyl tail that interacts hydrophobically with the C-terminal Atto647N, resulting in a predominantly curved, C-shaped conformation in the model

claim: 6,284 putative peptides were identified from 27,426 Atto647N localizations
quote: From 27,426 Atto647N localizations, 6,284 putative peptides containing one Atto647N dye and 4–5 fluorescein dyes were identified using nearest-neighbor criteria

claim: RMSD estimates stabilized beyond ~600 MD conformations; 10-200 gave bimodal distributions with a tail to ~1.2 nm
quote: RMSD estimates stabilized beyond ~600 conformations, indicating that 1001 conformations provided sufficient conformational coverage for stable matching

claim: Across 6,284 peptides the mean RMSD to best-matching MD conformations was 0.573 nm, sub-nanometre
quote: RMSD values were sub-nanometer, with a mean of 0.573 ± 0.151 nm

claim: Per-axis RMSD was comparable in x, y and z (0.317, 0.316, 0.325 nm), evidence of isotropic expansion
quote: Per-axis RMSD values were comparable across x, y, and z, consistent with isotropic expansion at the single-molecule level

claim: Fitting an isotropic scale factor gave a single-molecule expansion factor of 1055.92
quote: The optimal scale factor from this alignment and scaling procedure yielded a single-molecule expansion factor of 1055.92 ± 21.554

claim: Nearest-neighbour peak distances of 0.88-1.77 nm in the model appeared as 0.83-1.73 µm after expansion
quote: experimental kNN (1–5) peak distances spanned 0.83–1.73 µm and 0.83–1.88 µm, respectively

claim: Measured kNN distributions differed from randomized emitter placement at all ranks, with the KS D statistic rising from kNN1 to kNN5
quote: The KS D statistic increased, going from kNN1 to kNN5, indicating that higher-order nearest-neighbor structures were progressively less consistent with random spatial organization

claim: GFP reconstruction resolution improved with expansion: 17.37 A at 10x, 14.54 A at 50x, 11.63 A at 100x
quote: measuring 17.37 Å at 10× expansion (n = 885 from 3 independent gels [5], 14.54 Å at 50× expansion (n = 5,590 from 3 gels), and 11.63 Å at 100× expansion (n = 5,324 from 3 gels)

claim: Expansion microscopy reports only anchored residue positions, unlike electron microscopy which detects essentially all atoms
quote: In contrast to electron microscopy, which detects electron density from essentially all atoms, expansion microscopy reports only the positions of anchored residues

claim: Neighbouring lysines sit 0.44-1.41 nm apart depending on side chain orientation, putting the sampling limit near 10 A
quote: neighboring lysines may be separated by approximately 0.44 nm to 1.41 nm depending on side chain orientation

claim: The 11.63 A reconstruction approaches the ~10 A chemically imposed upper bound set by amino acid spacing
quote: placing an upper bound near amino acid level resolution of approximately 10 Å. The 11.63 Å reconstruction at 100× expansion approaches this chemically imposed limit

claim: In single-colour lysine labelling all fragment fluorescence registers at the original lysine anchoring coordinate, which blocks multicolour mapping
quote: all fluorescence from a given fragment is registered at the coordinate defined by the original lysine anchoring site

claim: True multicolour mapping would need a trivalent molecule targeting one residue type, coupling to the polymer and carrying a fluorophore
quote: we would need a trivalent molecule that would target a given amino acid selectively, allow for coupling to the polymer backbone, and permit fluorophore attachment

claim: Identifiability was simulated on 23,391 human proteins with solved structures using surface-exposed residues
quote: Simulations were performed on 23,391 human proteins with solved structures, using surface-exposed residues as candidate anchoring and labeling sites

claim: Distortion of 5 A reflected typical measured performance while 10 A was a conservative case above the 90th percentile
quote: 5 Å distortion reflects typical experimental performance, while 10 Å distortion represents a more conservative, suboptimal condition exceeding the 90th percentile

claim: A protein counted as identifiable when its closest RMSD match was its own undistorted structure
quote: A protein was considered identifiable if its closest RMSD match was its own undistorted structure

claim: Lysine labelling alone identified 89.3-93.3% of proteins at 5 A distortion and 78.0-83.8% at 10 A
quote: With single-color lysine labeling, 89.3–93.3% of proteins were identifiable at 5 Å distortion, for 75%–100% labeling efficiency, and 78.0–83.8% at 10 Å distortion and the same labeling efficiency

claim: Adding cysteine raised identifiability to 93.9-96.5% at 5 A and 84.2-89.2% at 10 A
quote: Adding cysteine labeling increased identifiability to 93.9–96.5% and 84.2–89.2%, respectively, assuming the same labeling efficiency as for lysine

claim: Three residue classes, adding acidic residues, reached 99.3-99.5% identifiability at 5 A, with diminishing gains beyond
quote: Incorporating acidic residues as a third class increased identifiability to 99.3–99.5% at 5 Å and 96.4–97.8% at 10 Å

claim: Prior iterative ExM methods (iExM, iU-ExM, pan-ExM) typically reach 16-25x linear expansion
quote: This strategy, used in iExM [7], iU-ExM [8], and pan-ExM [17], typically achieves 16- to 25-fold linear expansion

claim: Two mechanisms are proposed for preserving structure at 1000x: bond scission with reincorporation, or elastic stretching in DMAA gels
quote: One possibility is bond scission during swelling, followed by reincorporation of polymer fragments into successive interpenetrating gels during free-radical polymerization

claim: Expanded gels on a dry surface at room temperature changed in expansion factor by only 0.3% over 98 hours
quote: expanded gels maintained on a dry surface at room temperature changed in linear expansion factor by only 0.3

claim: At 1000x a 10 nm protein becomes ~10 um and a 10 um cell becomes ~10 mm, about the size of a mouse brain
quote: a ~10 nm protein expands to ~10 µm, comparable to a non-expanded cell, and a ~10 µm cell expands to ~10 mm, comparable to the size of a mouse brain

claim: Lysine side chains ~1 nm long whose terminal amines sample ~2 nm limit precision to roughly the side chain length, ~10 A
quote: lysine side chains are ~1 nm in length, and their terminal amines can sample positions over ~2 nm under conditions of rotational freedom

claim: Across three molecular species the preservation of spatial information reached ~6 A RMSD against molecular dynamics references
quote: preservation was demonstrated by a root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) of ~6 Å between experimentally observed molecular coordinates and molecular-dynamics reference structures
